items.title_orig: WE'RE TALKING ADAM-X, THE X-TREME, ALL DAY LONG, BABY!
items.article_text:
BLAST PEARL JAM AS LOUD AS YOU CAN AND GET IN THE CAR! WE'RE GOING TO THE MALL, BABY!
 KURT LODER IS ON MTV NEWS AND CLINTON IS PRESIDENT! IT'S ADAM-X TIME!
 Seriously though, it's fucking hilarious that Nicieza intended Adam-X to be the third Summers brother and just never got a chance to finalize that story and then, like twelve years later they invented Vulcan and basically gave him the EXACT same origin story as Adam-X.
 Also...
 EDITORIAL: So, he's a new character? What's his name?
 NICIEZA: ADAM-X.
 EDITORIAL: Oh. he's got the X in his name already? FUCKING SWEET. BUT I THINK WE NEED ANOTHER X.
 NICIEZA: ADAM-X, THE X-TREME.
 EDITORIAL: FUCK. YES.
 (Even Flow by Pearl Jam begins to loudly play in the office. It emanates not from speakers, but from some unseen force)
 EDITORIAL: WHAT'

I'm a guy tryna find more 90s bands to listen to! I mainly listen to grunge and alt rock
 my top 10 bands are:
  
The Smashing Pumpkins
 
Pearl Jam
 
Alice in Chains
 
Stone Temple Pilots
 
Soundgarden
 
Nirvana
 
Hole
 
Radiohead
 
Pavement
 
Gin Blossoms
 
 other notable bands I listen to are Weezer, MBV, Matchbox Twenty, Dinosaur Jr. and Everclear. A bit of Greenday, Sonic Youth and Foo Fighters, and I recently discovered Fugazi, Candlebox and Kyuss and I'm REALLY loving their music, though I've only listened to their first albums and am planning to listen to their works
